name: Phoenix Guest House
policy: mixed (gay-friendly, not exclusive; 18+, no stag/hen parties, under-25s not accepted at weekends)
description: A small guest house on Cocker Street, right in the middle of the gay quarter just off Queen Street. Travel Gay describes it as gay-owned, and a Queer in the World roundup calls it gay-friendly rather than exclusively gay. Most rooms are en suite, with a couple sharing facilities. Rooms have heating, a TV, tea and coffee and free Wi-Fi, and a light continental breakfast is self-service, with a cooked breakfast available at a diner a few steps away. House rules include quiet hours from 11pm and no smoking, pets or party groups. Booking-site reviews were still being posted in 2025 and 2026, so it appears to be trading.
notes: Gay-owned per Travel Gay (undated listing) and QITW (2023). No price or own website found.

name: Windsor House
price: Tripadvisor average standard room about 64-105 GBP/night (aggregator estimate)
description: A Victorian seaside villa guest house on Dickson Road, under a minute from the gay bars according to Travel Gay, which names owners Paul and Craig and describes it as gay-owned. Its Tripadvisor description says gay guests are welcome and that homophobia is not tolerated. Rooms are en suite and heated, with tea and coffee, toiletries and a full English breakfast served at individual tables. Pride weekend bookings are reportedly taken by phone so the house can aim for a very gay atmosphere. Tripadvisor shows guest reviews as recent as April 2025, and the listing is current for 2026.
notes: Latest review seen April 2025; confirm by phone.

name: The Edenfield Guest House
description: A guest house on Cocker Street, a short walk from the gay nightlife and the beach. Travel Gay says it is run by gay owners Mark and Phil and calls it award-winning, though it names no awards. Rooms are individually styled with en-suite shower, tea and coffee, a flat-screen TV and a mini-fridge, and a full English breakfast is cooked to order. A 2023 roundup lists it as a gay B&B with a bar and garden. I found no dated 2025-2026 evidence that it is still trading under this name, so treat it as unconfirmed.
notes: Do NOT confuse with Edenfield Number 42 (42 King Edward Ave, FY2 9TA), which has 2026 reviews but no gay mention. Possibly renamed; verify.

name: Grampian House
description: A bed and breakfast on Pleasant Street, on the quieter north side of the resort. Travel Gay describes it as gay-owned and names the owners as Richard and George, and a 2023 roundup repeats this. Rooms are en suite with tea and coffee, TV and free Wi-Fi, and breakfast is a full English or a lighter option. Aggregator sites still carry a listing, but I could not find dated 2025-2026 evidence that it is trading or still gay-run, so it is marked unclear.
notes: Postcode not found. Aggregators (University Rooms, Kayak) list it; recency unverified.

name: The Gynway Guesthouse
features: full English breakfast with vegetarian options
free Wi-Fi in some common areas
description: A six-bedroom guest house on Dickson Road, in North Shore near the Tower and Winter Gardens. Purple Roofs lists it as lesbian-owned, with a breakfast menu and pets welcome. Expedia shows a matching property with a cooked breakfast, a small lounge-bar, parking and a host who greets guests, though without any LGBTQ+ wording. It sits further up Dickson Road than the Queen Street core. Current trading is not confirmed by a dated source I could open.
notes: Purple Roofs page undated. Verify before publishing.

name: Thornhill Hotel
price: From 60 GBP per room per night with breakfast (Visit Lancashire; family en-suite from 80, large double from 70)
description: A guest house near Central Promenade on Wellington Road. A 2023 Queer in the World roundup calls it a gay B&B run by Adam and Dave, but its Visit Lancashire page makes no gay reference, and I could not confirm the roundup's description matches this address. It is some distance from Queen Street. Treat it as low confidence, and check directly before listing it as LGBTQ+-specific.
notes: Gay link rests only on 2023 blog; the Visit Lancashire page does not mention it.

name: The Trentham Hotel
description: A budget hotel with a purple frontage close to the promenade and nightlife, listed in a 2023 gay B&B roundup with an owner named Graham. The roundup does not say whether the owner is gay. No address, price or 2025-2026 evidence of LGBTQ+ positioning was found, so this is only a lead to verify.
